title: 第17章 棍刀相争一语点醒两天骄第18章 蛇群围堵诡道初显定军心
lines: 赤焰虎的尸体还在微微抽搐。
温热的鲜血顺着逆鳞的伤口汩汩流出，染红了脚下的青草地。
空气中弥漫着浓郁的血腥味和妖兽特有的腥臊味。
悟空拔出金箍棒，甩了甩上面的虎血，眼神炽热地盯着赤焰虎的腹部。
三阶妖兽的内丹，可是价值连城的宝贝，不仅能用来炼制高阶丹药，还能直接吸收提升修为。
“这头赤焰虎是我先发现的，也是我最后一击杀的，内丹归我。”
悟空伸手就要去剖取内丹。
“慢着。”
杨戬突然开口，手中的三尖两刃刀轻轻一挡，拦住了悟空的手。
“若不是我和哪吒牵制住它的前爪，你根本找不到出手的机会，内丹理应三人平分。”
“凭什么？”
悟空顿时炸毛，金箍棒往地上一杵，震得地面都微微颤抖。
“最后致命一击是我打的，内丹当然全归我。想要分一杯羹，先问问我手中的金箍棒答不答应。”
“那就试试。”
杨戬眼神一冷，握紧了三尖两刃刀，周身的灵力开始涌动。
两人之间的气氛瞬间剑拔弩张，空气仿佛都凝固了。
“别打了，别打了。”
柳若兮连忙上前劝架。
“不就是一颗内丹吗，我们再去找其他妖兽不就行了。”
“不行。”
悟空和杨戬异口同声地说道。
两人都是心高气傲之辈，争的早已不是一颗内丹，而是一口气。
哪吒抱着胳膊站在一旁，一脸看好戏的表情。
巨灵神挠了挠头，不知道该帮谁。
小蝶躲在庄周身后，怯生生地看着剑拔弩张的两人。
就在这时，一个鬼鬼祟祟的身影从树后钻了出来，正是张二狗。
他本来跟着其他小队进山，结果半路遇到妖兽袭击和队友走散，正好听到这边的打斗声就偷偷摸了过来。
看到地上赤焰虎的尸体，张二狗的眼睛瞬间就直了。
“我的乖乖，三阶赤焰虎啊，这要是把虎皮虎骨卖了，能换多少灵石啊。”
张二狗咽了口唾沫，眼睛滴溜溜地转。
看到悟空和杨戬正在对峙谁也没有注意到他，他顿时心生一计，蹑手蹑脚地绕到赤焰虎的尸体后面，从怀里掏出一把小刀就想去偷剖内丹。
content_en:
The body of the Red Flame Tiger was still twitching slightly.
Warm blood gurgled out along Ni Lian's wound, dyeing the green grass under his feet red.
The air was filled with the strong smell of blood and the unique fishy smell of monsters.
Wukong pulled out the golden cudgel, shook off the tiger blood on it, and stared at the belly of the red flame tiger with blazing eyes.
The inner elixir of a third-level monster is a priceless treasure. It can not only be used to refine high-level elixirs, but can also be directly absorbed to improve cultivation.
"I discovered this red flame tiger first, and it was also the one I killed with the last blow. The inner elixir belongs to me."
Wukong stretched out his hand to extract the inner elixir.
"Wait a minute."
Yang Jian suddenly spoke, and the three-pointed two-edged sword in his hand gently blocked Wukong's hand.
"If Nezha and I hadn't restrained its front paws, you wouldn't have had a chance to take action. The inner alchemy should be divided equally between the three of us."
"Why?"
Wukong's hair suddenly exploded, and the golden cudgel hit the ground, causing the ground to tremble slightly.
"I was the one who struck the last fatal blow, and of course all the inner elixir belongs to me. If you want to get a share of the pie, first ask if the golden cudgel in my hand will agree."
"Then try it."
Yang Jian's eyes turned cold, he gripped the three-pointed two-edged sword tightly, and the spiritual power around him began to surge.
The atmosphere between the two instantly became tense, and the air seemed to freeze.
"Stop fighting, stop fighting."
Liu Ruoxi quickly stepped forward to break up the fight.
"Isn't it just an inner elixir? We can just go find other monsters."
"No."
Wukong and Yang Jian said in unison.
Both of them are arrogant people, and what they are fighting for is no longer an inner elixir, but a breath.
Nezha stood aside with his arms folded, looking like he was watching a good show.
The giant spirit god scratched his head, not knowing who to help.
Xiaodie hid behind Zhuang Zhou and looked timidly at the two people who were at war with each other.
At this moment, a sneaky figure emerged from behind the tree, it was Zhang Ergou.
He originally followed other teams into the mountains, but was attacked by monsters along the way and separated from his teammates. He happened to hear the fighting here and sneaked over.
Seeing the body of the Red Flame Tiger on the ground, Zhang Ergou's eyes instantly went straight.
"My darling, you are a third-level red flame tiger. If you sell the tiger skin and bones, how many spiritual stones can you get in exchange for it?"
Zhang Ergou swallowed and rolled his eyes.
Seeing that Wukong and Yang Jian were confronting each other and no one noticed him, he immediately came up with a plan. He crept around behind the body of the Red Flame Tiger, took out a small knife from his arms and wanted to steal the inner elixir.
title_en: Chapter 17: Fighting with sticks and knives. One word awakens the pride of the two. Chapter 18: The group of snakes encircling the deceitful path begins to show the determination of the army.
